# Run book: Check the running service

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/check-the-running-service.md) | [Spec](../specs/check-the-running-service.md)

## Purpose

See the environment, runtime and effective configuration of a running API without shell access; secrets are masked.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Check the running service"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/operations/info`:

1. **Read the runtime facts.** The page loads the environment, runtime and machine the API runs on. Expect: The environment is shown.
2. **Find a setting.** Type part of a key to narrow the configuration list. Secret values are masked by the API. Expect: Only matching settings remain.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Configuration list is empty | The call failed | Read the error under Refresh and check authorization |
| A setting is missing | It is not set for this environment | Check the compose environment and appsettings files |

Related framework features: OoBDev.AspNetCore.Mvc; Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.
